negative.why: группировка только по пиццерии: адреса потеряны
negative.sql: SELECT MIN(person.address) AS address, pizzeria.name, COUNT(*) AS count_of_orders FROM person_order JOIN person ON person.id = person_order.person_id JOIN menu ON menu.id = person_order.menu_id JOIN pizzeria ON pizzeria.id = menu.pizzeria_id GROUP BY pizzeria.name ORDER BY 1, 2;

negative.why: сортировка сначала по названию, потом по адресу
negative.sql:
SELECT person.address, pizzeria.name, COUNT(*) AS count_of_orders
FROM person_order
JOIN person ON person.id = person_order.person_id
JOIN menu ON menu.id = person_order.menu_id
JOIN pizzeria ON pizzeria.id = menu.pizzeria_id
GROUP BY person.address, pizzeria.name
ORDER BY pizzeria.name, person.address;

negative.why: считаются разные люди, а не заказы
negative.sql:
SELECT person.address, pizzeria.name, COUNT(DISTINCT person.id) AS count_of_orders
FROM person_order
JOIN person ON person.id = person_order.person_id
JOIN menu ON menu.id = person_order.menu_id
JOIN pizzeria ON pizzeria.id = menu.pizzeria_id
GROUP BY person.address, pizzeria.name
ORDER BY person.address, pizzeria.name;
